title: Shadab Khan's one-wicket thriller
credits: Photos: Unsplash (Lahore, file) · Map: Natural Earth
lines: Pakistan have beaten England by one wicket, in one of the most dramatic finishes of the year.
It was the fourth match of the ODI tri-series, played in Lahore on Sunday evening.
England batted first and were bowled out for two hundred and forty-one, in forty-six point four overs.
Pakistan's chase looked to be slipping away, as wickets kept falling.
Then Shadab Khan took charge, and hit a superb century.
With nine wickets down, he and fast bowler Haris Rauf put together the final partnership.
Pakistan reached the target in forty-seven point one overs, with just one wicket in hand.
ESPNcricinfo called it a sensational one-wicket thriller.
President Zardari praised the team's determination, and Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif hailed their grit and fighting spirit.
The Prime Minister said the Lahore crowd's support represented the whole nation.
The tri-series also includes Sri Lanka, and Pakistan earlier beat both Sri Lanka and England in their opening matches.
